text: Alex: quick question on modeling soft pins in rollout metadata: add soft_expiry + affinity_priority or just stick to TTL+reason? Need something deterministic for resolvers and actionable for ops. Maria: soft_expiry + affinity_priority. TTL is binary and causes abrupt falls. Devon: prefer integer affinity_priority (higher = stronger). avoids float semantics and is easy for diffs. Priya: ops wants issued_at, issued_by, origin, human_reason and a short pin_id for tracing. also tenant_scope_closed boolean so we don't bloat metadata with per-tenant lists. Alex: example payload we discussed (kept out of schema, but restful fields): pin_type=soft, pin_id=pin-72b, issued_at=2025-02-03T16:00:00Z, soft_expiry=2025-02-10T16:00:00Z, affinity_priority=12, origin=canary/rollout-42, issued_by=autodeploy, human_reason="perf regression", tenant_scope_closed=true, grace_window_ms=30000. Devon: client resolver guidance: degrade affinity after soft_expiry instead of hard reject; sample pseudocode: add affinity_priority then if now>soft_expiry subtract ~70% of that priority so variant drops but may still win if base_priority high. Maria: telemetry tags: pin_id, origin, affinity_priority, pin_type, soft_expiry. OpsBot: alerting logic: on soft_expiry emit a warning if any traffic remains; if pinned traffic >5% after grace_window_ms -> page, otherwise create advisory. Priya: runbook: probe pinned variant on expiry, measure traffic, if >5% page, else advisory and investigate. Alex: action items: I'll update RFC with fields and resolver semantics, add compatibility notes for older clients (ignore unknown fields), doc SDK guidance. Devon: I'll add pin_lifecycle events (created/updated/soft_expired/evicted) and affinity delta events. Maria: tiny nit: SDK default for absent grace_window_ms = 30000ms. Alex: noted. OpsBot: created note #infra-pin-schema-2025 (auto).
